name: Stellar Drop Earrings
desc: A pair of slender gold rays, each tipped with a single hand-set cubic zirconia that catches light like a distant star.

name: Starlight Pendant Necklace
desc: A five-point star pendant suspended on a fine cable chain, designed to sit just below the collarbone.

name: Nova Bangle
desc: A solid, sculptural cuff with a soft brushed texture that mimics the surface of a star mid-flare.

name: Comet Ring
desc: A trailing line of pavé stones sweeps across the band like a comet's tail.

name: Moonlit Hoop Earrings
desc: Clean, architectural hoops with a soft matte-to-polish gradient, echoing the shift from new moon to full.

name: Crescent Pendant
desc: A single crescent, hand-finished and suspended off-center, designed to catch light at the collarbone.

name: Luna Bangle
desc: The quieter twin to the Nova Bangle — cool-toned, soft-brushed, built for stacking or wearing alone.

name: Tide Ring
desc: A gently waved band, inspired by the moon's pull on the tide.

name: Leo Constellation Necklace
desc: The Leo constellation rendered in miniature, each star a hand-set stone joined by fine gold lines.

name: Gemini Signet Ring
desc: A modern signet engraved with the Gemini glyph, for the sign that holds two truths at once.

name: Aquarius Drop Earrings
desc: Fluid, wave-inspired drops set with a single stone, marking the water-bearer's sign in gold.

name: Zodiac Birthstone Bracelet
desc: A fine chain bracelet finished with your sign's birthstone charm — made to order by month.
